claims.claim: For independent matching batch scores Z in [0,1], the fractional log-likelihood increment Z log(b/a)+(1-Z)log((1-b)/(1-a)) yields a valid one-sided sequential test under true means p<=a and false means p>=b. A two-boundary test plus the configured fixed-horizon KL fallback has each directional candidate error at most delta.
conditions: correct acquired prefix and exact conditional fiber sampler
fixed comparator and fixed incident-item bad set
fresh independent prefix and position seeds for each batch
admitted degree d and positive gap 2^(-d)-4 epsilon-c_m

claims.claim: Privately drawing Y|Z~Bernoulli(Z) gives iid Bernoulli(p) observations for a fixed score distribution. Exact likelihood-ratio boundaries bound false accept and true reject; endpoint binomial tails give a deterministic cap whose exhaustion returns UNKNOWN.
conditions: private coin is applied after each complete score, not to comparator responses
batch scores use independent fresh random seeds
no repeated pair is treated as a fresh source coin

claims.claim: For H preallocated candidate slots, deterministic per-slot false-accept, true-reject and UNKNOWN budgets summing separately to beta_v bound their total by beta_v, conditional on correctness up to the first wrong acceptance.

At d=2, epsilon=0.0331, m=11, H=1000, beta_v=0.05, the Bernoulli-LR variant has cap 7443 batches, endpoint expected stops 1572.02 and 1404.78 batches, and per-candidate worst-case 900603 ordered pair requests. The p_s02b Hoeffding design uses cap 19601; q_s09's bounded-score KL optimizer uses m=12, cap 5226 and 752544 requests at the same per-test alpha.
limits: statistical kernel only; no comparator batch stream was simulated
no end-to-end learner cost or advantage is established
floating-point LLR cutoffs use a one-count guard; binomial masses are accumulated exactly as rational numbers

claims.claim: The score gap uses the admitted degree-d RM minimum-distance bound. This validator does not recognize degree, bijectivity, partial-flag existence, or the bad-set promise from comparison queries.
